digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD — Ubuntu runner scheduling and test execution
key_entities: not integration and not external selector
propositions: Ubuntu default-tier test cells occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run due to four redundant mechanisms: bridge-cadence YAML reparsing (5.7 min), render_unit exhaustive eligible-unit assertion (negligible via short-circuit), pandoc hardening dual-subprocess execution (hardenable via immutable legacy oracle), and AST provenance fixture setup (caller/parent index rebuild per-cell).

Bridge-cadence test 1,440-minute comprehension repeatedly parses the same workflow YAML instead of reusing a single preloaded parse, accounting for 100–131 seconds per Ubuntu cell and eliminating the cost of exhaustive minute arithmetic.

Pandoc corpus and hardening tests invoke the real binary 3,421 times per run with process-startup dominating latency; the legacy _convert verification can safely use immutable expected outputs while keeping product _convert live, reducing subprocess calls without violating ADR 0095.
Complexity-lock static policy evaluation executes redundantly in every OS/Python matrix cell (52–55 seconds Ubuntu, 45 seconds macOS) and can execute once in the lint job.
Jira DC live suite is already routed outside the Verified hot path via 'not external' selector and requires no remediation; hermetic unit tests provide fast coverage within current latency.

AST provenance fixture discovery repeatedly recomputes enclosing callers and parent relationships; building indices once per process preserves all 24 (key, expr, verdict) tuples while eliminating ~130.9M redundant ast.walk iterations.
